name: ninjaone
description: NinjaOne RMM for Claude: fleet health, devices, patching, alerts, reports, ticketing and documentation through the NinjaOne Public API v2. Read-only by default.

client_id.title: NinjaOne client ID
client_id.description: From Administration > Apps > API in NinjaOne (API Services app, client credentials grant).

client_secret.title: NinjaOne client secret
client_secret.description: Stored in your system keychain, never in settings.json.

region.title: NinjaOne region
region.description: The instance your API client lives in: us (app.ninjarmm.com), us2, eu, ca or oc.

mode.title: Write mode
mode.description: read keeps every change refused. write allows changes; destructive actions still need the next option.

allow_destructive.title: Allow destructive actions
allow_destructive.description: true allows deletes, reboots, scripts, patch installs and replacements. Needs write mode.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma-separated groups to list, or all. Default: core,devices,alerts,reports,actions,ticketing,views.

allowed_org_ids.title: Allowed organization ids
allowed_org_ids.description: Optional hard boundary: comma-separated NinjaOne organization ids this plugin may touch. Leave empty for all.
